title: Affine ideal-power coefficient span
statement: With the data of lem-weil-pbc-ideal-powers-local-coefficient-span, if W is affine and W ≤ U, then every section of the ideal-power module product over W maps under the product inclusion into the span of the restricted generators with coefficients from I^m.

proof.text: Use the surjective affine section base-change comparison from U to W. Tensor induction followed by span induction on the U-factor proves that the restrictions of the given generators span F(W).
Apply ideal_comap_appLE to the affine top open of Spec A. ideal_top_ofIdealTop and Ideal.map_map identify J(W) with the extension of I along the displayed coefficient ring map.

For any quasi-coherent K and morphism i:K -> O_X, the affine abelian image formula lifts an image section to the multiplication tensor. The canonical image/abelian-image isomorphism relates this image to idealModuleProduct. The affine tensor comparison and tensor induction show that the section belongs to range(i_W) times F(W); pure tensors map to i_W(s) times v.

For m>0 the existing affine ideal-power formulas give quasi-coherence of J^m and range of its inclusion equal to J(W)^m. For m=0 the module is the structure sheaf and the inclusion is the identity, whose range is top.

Substitute the power range and the spanning family in the multiplication membership. Ideal.map_pow, the definition of Ideal.map, and Mathlib Submodule.span_smul_span express this as the span of the image of I^m times the range of the restricted generators, which is the desired generating set.

proof_origin.note: Direct reduction through affine base change, affine image and tensor formulas, and ideal powers; no finite-expansion restatement and no new holes.

theorem idealPowersLocalCoefficientSpan_affine {A : Type v} [CommRing A]
    {X : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (I : Ideal A) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (r : ℕ) (u : Fin r → Γ(F, U))
    (hu : Submodule.span Γ(X, U) (Set.range u) = ⊤)
    (m : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hWU : W ≤ U)
    (t : (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F).val.obj
      (op W)) :
    ((Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι m).2 F).app
        W).hom t ∈
      Submodule.span Γ(X, W)
        {z | ∃ (i : Fin r) (a : A), a ∈ I ^ m ∧
          z = (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫
            f.appLE ⊤ W le_top).hom a) •
              F.val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (u i)}
